rules.zh: 核心句式是 Since when 固定的開首只是：【Since when】 後面的結構須按照問題的時態、語態及意思而決定。不要把某一個完整句式誤當成唯一用法。
rules.en: The core expression is “Since when” The fixed opening is simply: Since when The words following it depend on the tense, voice and meaning of the question. Since when Do not treat one complete sentence shell as the only possible form.

rules.zh: 與 do、does 及 did 連用你從甚麼時候起會在早餐前喝咖啡？ 這間咖啡店從甚麼時候起會收取自來水費？ 你從甚麼時候起成了教育專家？ 遲到從甚麼時候起變得可以接受？ 在 do、does 或 did 後，主要動詞必須使用原形。
rules.en: With “do”, “does” and “did” Present habit or current claim Since when + do / does + subject + base verb? Since when do you drink coffee before breakfast? Since when does the café charge for tap water? Past change or event Since when + did + subject + base verb? Since when did you become an expert on education? Since when did being late become acceptable? After do, does or did, use the base form of the main verb. Since when does he work here? Since when does he works here?

rules.zh: 與現在完成式連用這個形式適合描述一種在過去開始，並延續至現在的情況。你從甚麼時候起認識新經理？ 學校從甚麼時候起提供夜間課程？
rules.en: With the present perfect Since when + have / has + subject + past participle? This form is useful when a situation began in the past and continues to the present. Since when have you known the new manager? Since when has the school offered evening classes?

rules.zh: 與現在完成進行式連用這個形式適合描述較早開始，而且仍然持續的活動。你從甚麼時候起一直在家工作？ 以 Noah 為例：Noah 從甚麼時候起一直在學韓語？
rules.en: With the present perfect continuous Since when + have / has + subject + been + V-ing? Use this form for an activity that began earlier and is still continuing. Since when have you been working from home? Since when has Noah been learning Korean?

rules.zh: 與 be 動詞連用這間商店從甚麼時候起星期日也營業？ 本區居民從甚麼時候起被排除在這些會議之外？ 義工從甚麼時候起被要求自行支付制服費用？
rules.en: With “be” Since when + is / are / was / were + subject + complement? Since when is this shop open on Sundays? Since when are local residents excluded from these meetings? Since when were volunteers expected to pay for their own uniforms?

rules.zh: 與情態動詞連用學生從甚麼時候起可以在課堂上使用平板電腦？ 乘客從甚麼時候起必須出示身分證明文件？ 家長從甚麼時候起應該在網上預約？ 情態動詞須移到主語前。
rules.en: With modal verbs Since when + modal verb + subject + base verb? Possible modal verbs include: can could should must will would. Since when can students use tablets in class? Since when must passengers show identification? Since when should parents book appointments online? The modal verb moves before the subject.

rules.zh: 與被動句連用這個房間從甚麼時候起被用作工作室？ 顧客從甚麼時候起獲准退回已開封的產品？ 改寫時不得刪去原句的被動意思。
rules.en: With passive structures Since when + have / has + subject + been + past participle? Since when has this room been used as a studio? Since when have customers been allowed to return opened products? Do not remove the passive meaning during the transformation.

rules.zh: 與 there 連用停車場從甚麼時候起開始收費？ 在這個句式中，there 放在助動詞後面。
rules.en: With “there” Since when + has / have + there + been + noun phrase? Since when has there been a charge for using the car park? In this pattern, there comes after the auxiliary verb.

rules.zh: 以動名詞短語作主語主語不一定是人物。在午飯時間繼續工作從甚麼時候起在這裏變得正常？ 拒絕回答問題從甚麼時候起被視為有罪的證明？
rules.en: With a gerund phrase as the subject The subject does not have to be a person. Since when has working through lunch been normal here? Since when has refusing to answer a question counted as proof of guilt?

rules.zh: 附加資料並非核心句式的一部分你從甚麼時候起在家工作？ 你從甚麼時候起逢星期五在家工作？ 你從甚麼時候起在沒有通知經理的情況下在家工作？ 和 without informing the manager 是附加資料，並非固定句式的一部分。
rules.en: Optional extensions are not part of the core expression The core question may be complete without extra information: Since when have you worked from home? Extra information may be added: Since when have you worked from home on Fridays? Since when have you worked from home without informing the manager? The phrases on Fridays and without informing the manager are optional extensions. They are not part of the fixed expression. on Fridays

rules.zh: 保留原句詞彙本練習測試如何組成 Since when...? 問句。除非文法上有需要，否則不得把原句的主要動詞或重要詞語換成近義詞。不要無故把 care about 改成 be concerned about。
rules.en: Preserve the original vocabulary This exercise tests the construction of a Since when...? question. Do not replace the original main verb or other important words with synonyms unless a grammatical change is necessary. Source: You care about office rules now. When did that begin? Answer: Since when do you care about office rules? Do not unnecessarily change care about into be concerned about.

rules.zh: 所有答案都必須以 Since when 開始由於 Since when 是固定的疑問句開首，因此不能自然地移到其他位置。真正的文法挑戰在於選擇 Since when 後面的正確結構，而不是猜測它在句中的位置。
rules.en: All answers must begin with “Since when” Because Since when is a fixed question opener, it cannot naturally be moved to different positions. The grammatical challenge lies in choosing the correct structure after it: did + subject + base verb do / does + subject + base verb have / has + subject + past participle have / has + subject + been + V-ing be + subject + complement modal verb + subject + base verb passive structures there + be different types of subjects.

rules.zh: 注意語氣目標表達【Since when...?】可以帶有驚訝、懷疑或質問的語氣。這項規則何時開始？ 這項規則將由哪一天起生效？ 你在這裏工作了多久？ 只應在較強烈的語氣符合情境時使用 Since when...?。
rules.en: Be careful with tone Since when...? can sound surprised, doubtful or confrontational. Since when...? For a neutral or polite enquiry, the following may be more suitable: When did this rule begin? From what date will this rule apply? How long have you worked here? Use Since when...? when its stronger tone fits the situation.

benefits.zh: 能清楚追問事情由何時開始聽者會立即明白，你正在追問一種習慣、情況、規則或想法的開始時間。
benefits.en: It asks clearly when something began The listener immediately understands that you are asking for the starting point of a habit, situation, rule or belief.

benefits.zh: 能表達驚訝或懷疑這個句式不只可以詢問時間，亦可以顯示新資料令人意外或難以相信。你甚麼時候開始提供職業建議？ 你從甚麼時候起竟然一直在提供職業建議？ 第二個問題帶有較強烈的反應。
benefits.en: It can show surprise or disbelief Instead of merely asking for a date, the structure can show that the new information is unexpected or difficult to believe. Compare: When did you start giving career advice? Since when have you been giving career advice? The second question carries a stronger reaction.

benefits.zh: 能質疑缺乏根據的說法當某人突然聲稱自己擁有權力、專業知識或許可時，可以使用這個句式提出質疑。你從甚麼時候起有權取消別人的預約？
benefits.en: It helps challenge an unsupported claim You can use the structure when someone suddenly claims to have authority, expertise or permission. Since when have you had the authority to cancel other people’s bookings?

benefits.zh: 能配合多種文法形式同一個開首可以配合：現在式及過去式；完成式及進行式；情態動詞；主動句及被動句；人物、事物及活動主語。因此，它是一個靈活的說話及寫作框架。
benefits.en: It works with many different grammar forms The same opening can be used with: present and past forms perfect and continuous forms modal verbs active and passive sentences people, things and activities as subjects. This makes it a flexible speaking and writing frame.

benefits.zh: 能更直接地表達不同意未經證實的傳聞從甚麼時候起可以當作證據？ 說話者並非單純詢問日期，而是在質疑這項說法是否合理。
benefits.en: It can make disagreement more direct Since when can an unverified rumour count as evidence? The speaker is not simply asking for a date. The speaker is questioning the logic of the claim.

benefits.zh: 能增加問句變化學生不需要反覆使用 When did...? 或 How long have...?，而可以用另一種方式追問事情的開始時間。
benefits.en: It helps vary question structures Instead of repeatedly using When did...? or How long have...?, learners gain another way to ask about the beginning of a situation.
